name: SaaS Revenue-Based
description: Non-dilutive runway based on recurring billing parameters.

cost.description: Tethered to live operational revenues. No compound index metrics.

documentation.description: Direct automated protocols to Stripe, Plaid, AWS accounts. Decision in minutes.

collateral.description: Enterprise billing collateral structures protect liquid assets directly.

name: Growth Venture Debt
description: Designed to support equity tranches with minimal equity dilution.

cost.description: Warrant coverage allocation ranges between 0.5% - 1.5% only.

documentation.description: Requires formal audit metrics: standard quality of earnings, cap table, cohorts.

collateral.description: Target security lies within platform intellectual properties. No founders dilution.

name: SBA 7(a) Term Loan
description: Sovereign-backed long term loan structures with strict compliance rules.

cost.description: SBA regulated ceiling matrix parameters apply to baseline interest yields.

documentation.description: Strict tax record structures, legal entity checks, and manual federal compliance audits.

collateral.description: Includes primary personal assets, liquid bank positions, or residential deeds.

name: Matrix Ledger Clearing
description: Convert enterprise account receivables directly into zero-wait protocol cash.

cost.description: Straight line discounting computed strictly against invoice validation parameters.

documentation.description: Requires zero human processing. Instantly sync bookkeeping platforms via webhook.

collateral.description: Lien mapped to nominated corporate invoices. No personal risk covenants.

name: Founder Bridge Protocol
description: Fast-track bridged deployment protecting runway before major institutional rounds.

cost.description: Accrues annually. Converts directly to equity upon next qualified pricing event.

documentation.description: Standardized NVCA framework documents, cap table audit, and major investor signoffs.

collateral.description: No operational assets mortgaged. Converts to equity at pre-determined valuation discounts.
